hide.label: Hide
hide.describe: Warm ochre hide over the back, flanks, neck, head, tail and legs.

belly.label: Belly
belly.describe: Cream underside: the lower jaw, throat, the lower half of the neck, the bib between the shoulders, the belly and its lower flank between the legs, the strip between the hind legs and the underside of the tail.

blend.label: Blend
blend.describe: The soft upper edge of the cream underside: a band of a tone between the hide and the cream along the tail, the belly and the neck. Keep it between those two colours.

feet.label: Feet
feet.describe: The broad feet below the wrist and the hock and the toes, a shade off the hide.

mark.label: Mark
mark.describe: Dark grey-brown: the blotches along the back beside each plate row, the dashed stripe on the midline, the socket round each eye, the nails and the closed seam of the mouth.

plate.label: Plate
plate.describe: The main colour of every back plate (warm brown, rust-red or ochre by `plateColour`).

plateTrim.label: Plate trim
plateTrim.describe: The plates' second colour: the dark band low across each plate and its dark cap (umber), the cream caps (rust) or the dark band alone (banded).

spike.label: Spike
spike.describe: Bone-white of the six tail spikes of the thagomizer.

dark.label: Dark
dark.describe: The eyes and the nostrils, the darkest thing on the animal; it also deepens the throat at the back of the open mouth.

mouth.label: Mouth
mouth.describe: Flesh inside the mouth, seen when the jaw opens: the floor in this tone, the palate a shade darker in its own shadow, the throat darker still.

tongue.label: Tongue
tongue.describe: The fat tongue lying along the floor of the mouth.

size.label: Size
size.describe: Scales the whole animal and its bind skeleton evenly for a herd: 1.0 is the adult of the reference, about 6.5 m from snout to spike tips, 2.98 m over the back and 3.8 m to the tallest plate; 0.6 a 3.9 m juvenile; 1.4 a 9.1 m old adult. Proportions do not change and the feet stay on y = 0.

plates.label: Plates
plates.describe: How many back plates stand in the two rows from behind the head to the spikes, counted over both rows (even values; an odd one is rounded). 24 is the reference, twelve a side. The rows always span the same run, tallest over the hips and mid-back; fewer plates stand further apart and broader, more stand closer and narrower so the crest reads denser.

plateSize.label: Plate size
plateSize.describe: Scales every back plate about its base: 1.0 is the reference, the tallest plate standing 0.84 m above the back; 0.75 a low crest of small plates with wide gaps; 1.25 tall broad plates that overlap in profile. The body, the plate count and the spikes do not change.

tail.label: Tail length
tail.describe: Length of the tail behind the rump, its plates, marks and spikes carried along: 1.0 is the reference, a thin tail about 2.0 m long carried low; 0.8 a 1.6 m tail; 1.2 a 2.4 m tail. Its root, depth, droop and the spikes' size do not change.

plateColour.label: Plate colour
plateColour.describe: Paint pattern and colours of the plates: umber is warm brown plates with a dark umber band low across each and a dark cap (the reference); rust is rust-red plates with cream caps; banded is ochre plates with a dark band and no cap. Sets the plate and plateTrim zones, which explicit colour values still override.
